entries.description: Human-readable environment variable reference, rendered from the configuration manifest. Hand edits are drift.
entries.read_when: You want the configuration surface in prose rather than JSON.

entries.description: Architecture decision records for durable choices. The `components` list in each ADR's front matter is the authoritative decision-to-component link; a component's decision_refs is derived from it at sync.
entries.read_when: A component references an ADR, or you are about to revisit a durable decision.

entries.description: Current architectural state, open findings, accepted exceptions, active contracts, and the most recent material changes.
entries.read_when: Orienting on a repository you have not touched recently, or checking what is currently unresolved.

entries.description: This index. The first thing to read before selecting any deeper governance material.
entries.read_when: Always, before opening anything else under governance/.

entries.description: The governance contract: version, protected kernel, and the catalog specification.
entries.read_when: Changing governance versioning, the protected kernel, or what appears in the catalog.

entries.description: The typed edge vocabulary for the repository graph, with the provenance fields every edge instance must carry.
entries.read_when: Adding a graph extractor or a new edge kind; checking what a graph relationship means.

entries.description: The typed node vocabulary for the repository graph. Every graph node kind an extractor may emit is declared here first.
entries.read_when: Adding a graph extractor or a new node kind; checking what the graph can represent.

entries.description: Per-page chain coverage: which pages reach the backend through which proxy handlers, which chains are broken, and where the WebSocket exception is consumed.
entries.read_when: Planning a change that spans the proxy hop, or checking what a page actually touches.

entries.description: Dependency cycles per language, each classified import-time or deferred-import.
entries.read_when: A cycle finding fires, or before restructuring modules that import each other.

entries.description: Structural centrality rankings per language view, and components whose declared invariants lack test coverage ranked by how central their code is. Churn analysis is cache-only.
entries.read_when: Judging review depth for a change, or picking where missing invariant tests hurt most.

entries.description: Modules with no importer and no explaining classification, plus counts of what each exclusion class absorbed.
entries.read_when: An orphan finding fires, or when hunting dead code during a debt sweep.

entries.description: Structured change records, one per material governed change. Query by component, path, or date rather than reading the directory.
entries.read_when: Asking why something is the way it is, or what a recent change to this area did.

entries.description: Generated index of every ADR: id, title, status, date, components, supersedes, and the derived superseded_by.
entries.read_when: Resolving an ADR id to file, status, and components without opening every ADR.

entries.description: Evidence about governance behavior itself: misses, false positives, and context quality.
entries.read_when: Proposing a change to governance extraction, policy, or ranking.

entries.description: Components with no home directory: image-only services, host runtimes, database-resident surfaces, and multi-root frontend features.
entries.read_when: Declaring a component that cannot hold a .governance.json, or changing architectural intent.

entries.description: Deliberate, reviewed departures from policy, each with its reason and scope.
entries.read_when: A check fires on something that looks intentional, or you need to record a new deliberate departure.

entries.description: Generated-versus-curated ownership rules, the generated-file registry, and generator-divergence records.
entries.read_when: Asking whether a file may be hand-edited, or what a generator upgrade will conflict with.

entries.description: Test frameworks, gating environment variables, ratcheted coverage floors, and which declared invariants have a dedicated test. Review judgment, hand-maintained; the coverage floors mirror backend/pyproject.toml and frontend/vitest.config.ts and are updated with them.
entries.read_when: Deciding what proves a change, or asking whether an invariant is actually covered.

entries.description: The merged repository model: generated facts joined with curated intent, with merge conflicts surfaced explicitly.
entries.read_when: You need one view of a component including both what it is and what it is meant to be.

entries.description: Agents, tools, and MCP connections along orthogonal dimensions, with the standing security findings that constrain them.
entries.read_when: Changing agents, toolsets, MCP configuration, or anything touching tool authorization.

entries.description: Every component, compiled from directory annotations and curated declarations.
entries.read_when: Asking what owns a path or behavior.

entries.description: Environment variables across backend, frontend, and Compose surfaces, with classification and consumers. Names only, never values.
entries.read_when: Adding, renaming, or removing configuration, or tracing who consumes a variable.

entries.description: PostgreSQL and pgvector objects, the migration graph, Redis logical databases, the two-level embedding cache, and S3 buckets.
entries.read_when: Touching migrations, the embedding dimension contract, Redis allocations, or bucket layout.

entries.description: HTTP contracts, the mandatory Next.js proxy hop, the WebSocket chat exception, SSE, and the WebSocket event inventory.
entries.read_when: Changing an API route, a proxy handler, a frontend client, or a WebSocket event.

entries.description: The read-gate surface: allowed path sets and gated corpus roots, compiled for the PreToolUse hook script.
entries.read_when: Changing the [gate] table or component ownership, or diagnosing a gate decision.

entries.description: Compose services resolved across the file-stack x profile matrix, plus host runtimes and volume classification.
entries.read_when: Changing Compose files, ports, profiles, volumes, or anything about how services are exposed.

entries.description: Layering, component boundaries, and dependency direction rules.
entries.read_when: Adding a dependency between components, or moving code across a boundary.

entries.description: Contracts that must not break silently: the embedding dimension agreement, migration heads, WebSocket events, and catalog-to-backend mapping.
entries.read_when: Changing a contract that something outside its own file depends on.

entries.description: Change-record requirements, CI job references, and the policy-maturity promotion ladder.
entries.read_when: Asking whether a change needs a record, or promoting a policy to a stricter maturity.

entries.description: Exposure invariants, secret handling, MCP authorization, and the standing security findings.
entries.read_when: Changing exposure, credentials, tool authorization, or anything touching the MCP surface.

entries.description: The protected kernel rules. Blocking from day one; no automation may weaken them.
entries.read_when: Changing governance itself.

entries.description: JSON Schemas defining every governance document. Executed by the checks, not read into context.
entries.read_when: Authoring a new governance document by hand, or changing a document's shape.

entries.description: Scaffolds the governance CLI writes from. Editing one changes the shape of every document created after it, never a document already written.
entries.read_when: Writing a new ADR by hand, or changing what `governance decision propose` produces.

entries.description: Trusted validator IDs mapped to Make targets and fixed commands. The only way a validator may be invoked.
entries.read_when: Selecting what to run to prove a change works, or adding a new validator.

entries.description: The bounded views governance visualize can render: sources, focus semantics, and node budgets.
entries.read_when: Adding or reshaping a view, or checking what governance visualize can draw.
